title: 道德热线事实叙述简报
instruction:
您是 Ana Zuniga，Heronbank Systems 的一线生产主管，Ezra Kalinowski，我们的质量经理，需要为同行评审员提供简短的培训简报，同行评审员将在三周后客户 IATF 监督访问之前帮助准备质量文件帐户。匿名道德热线电话称，B 档扭矩验证检查在运行前已签署。该材料应使用 Heronbank Systems 案例作为其工作示例：十一个晚上的安灯打印输出包含间隙，有一个报废批次标签可用，并且主管的笔记本记录了2上午的排队情况；这些间隙似乎与固定装置的停机时间一致，而提示则指向特定的人。尚未有人确定检查是否延迟执行、提前记录、遗漏或错误签名，并且该文件不得将线索变成调查结果。我们也正处于从纸质签核到电子扭矩捕获的转变过程中，因此审核者需要了解有关过渡期的内容以及完整的最终状态记录应支持哪些内容。
有一种不常见但严重的情况需要单独讨论：如果证据表明未经检查的扭矩结果可能导致产品被发布给客户，则审核人员必须知道这种情况如何改变事实说明及其升级语言，而不会将培训转化为指控或操作说明。请在您启动的工作目录的顶层创建`factual_narrative_peer_briefing.docx`，并使用该文件名。让它成为质量或生产同行评审员的实用教学讲义，之前没有写过调查叙述，而不是法律意见，也不是对任何人进行纪律处分的建议。它应该教导观察到的记录、合理的推论、未解决的差异和指控之间的区别；展示如何确定叙述的日期和界限、保留来源线索、描述缺失或冲突的记录，以及保持身份和意图主张与证据相称；并包括一个基于 Heronbank Systems 事实的紧凑工作示例，清楚地将已知事实与说明性措辞分开。
比较美国和加拿大安大略省的文档含义，明确指定两个司法管辖区，同时将比较保持在一般工作场所记录和客户质量水平，而不是主张特定的法规、认证解释或法律结论。审阅者应该能够使用讲义而无需询问其作者标签的含义。保持不超过两页，使用简单的语言，使各个部分易于浏览，并以简洁的起草标准而不是未来行动的列表结束。请勿包含系统逐点说明、访谈脚本、纪律建议、任何指定人员伪造记录的调查结果或案件中不存在的事实，除非它们被明确标记为假设说明。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `factual_narrative_peer_briefing.docx` — 为新的质量或生产同行评审员提供的简洁、实用的培训讲义，内容涉及从不完整的扭矩验证记录中准备可辩护的事实调查叙述。 （完全使用指定的文件名写入顶级起始工作目录。；在普通办公用纸上呈现时最多两页；使用可读的正文文本和清晰的导航。；使用简单的语言和说明性示例，同时区分案例事实、证据、推论、指控和假设说明。；解决从纸质签核到电子扭矩捕获的过渡以及完成的电子最终状态。；包括对罕见的潜在客户释放后果的单独处理。；命名并比较美国和加拿大安大略省的情况没有法律结论的一般文档实践水平。；不要提供系统点击率、面试问题、纪律建议、未经支持的案例事实或某人伪造记录的结论。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
FACTUAL NARRATIVE  /  Peer Reviewer Briefing
Heronbank Systems — preparing a bounded quality-file account for Ezra Kalinowski, Quality Manager
Purpose. Write what the available records support, show their limits, and leave accountability decisions outside the narrative.
1  Label the evidence before you draft
Observed record
What a source directly shows: e.g., an andon printout has a gap.
Inference
A reasonable reading of facts, stated as such: the gap appears to align with downtime.


Unresolved discrepancy
A difference, absence, or conflict the records do not settle.
Allegation / lead
A report to examine. An anonymous tip does not establish identity, intent, or falsification.


Keep propositions separate
A blank or timing mismatch is not interchangeable with a late entry, missing entry, failed check, or falsified entry. State only the proposition the records establish. Do not fill a gap with a presumed sequence, motive, or person.
A dated, bounded narrative
Scope & time window. Name the process, B shift, and the date/time window reviewed. Anchor each statement to a date or time where the source permits.
Evidence & chronology. Place records in time order; distinguish source observation from inference.
Limitations & boundary. Name missing/conflicting records and end with what the evidence does and does not establish.
Source trail = retrievable evidence
Identify the record type. Use the record’s title/type, relevant date or shift, and available identifier, lot/job, page, or image reference.
Preserve provenance. Say whether it is a paper original, scan, printout, notebook, or electronic export; preserve the version reviewed.
Describe absence plainly. “No matching record was located in the reviewed set” is different from “the check did not occur.”
2  Worked example — Heronbank Systems (known facts vs. illustrative wording)
KNOWN CASE FACTS
• Eleven nights of andon printouts contain gaps.
• One scrapped-lot tag is available.
• The supervisor’s notebook records a 2 a.m. line walk.
• Gaps appear to coincide with fixture downtime.
• An anonymous hotline tip points toward a particular person.
ILLUSTRATIVE NARRATIVE WORDING
“Within the reviewed eleven-night andon-printout set, gaps are present. The available scrapped-lot tag and the supervisor notebook entry for a 2 a.m. line walk are retained as separate sources. The observed timing appears to align with fixture downtime; this is possible context, not proof that a torque check was performed, late-recorded, missed, or falsely signed. The hotline report is an allegation/lead and does not establish a person’s identity, intent, or falsification. The reviewed records do not resolve the discrepancy.”
3  Record-system transition and completed end state
Interim: paper → electronic
Bound the changeover period. Identify which records are paper sign-offs and which are electronic captures; their provenance, timing, and completeness may differ. Do not portray a transition gap as proof of performance or nonperformance.
Completed electronic record
A usable end-state record supports a torque event time, linkage to the relevant job or unit, attributable user/event identity, result/status, and an auditable history of entries or changes. Describe these evidentiary attributes—not software steps.
RARE, SERIOUS EXCEPTION — possible customer release
If evidence suggests an unchecked torque result may have permitted product release to a customer, state the exposure and the records bearing on it: “The reviewed material raises a potential customer-release exposure; it does not establish that release occurred or that the result was unchecked.” Separate the possible exposure, the evidence, and any conclusion. Use the quality-file escalation language required by the organization without converting this briefing into an accusation or operating instruction.


4  General documentation context: United States and Ontario, Canada

United States
Ontario, Canada
Shared expectation
Neutral, traceable workplace and customer-quality records; preserve the basis and limits of a statement.
Neutral, traceable workplace and customer-quality records; preserve the basis and limits of a statement.
Practical emphasis
Maintain disciplined retention/access handling and a retrievable source trail for the quality-file context.
Maintain disciplined retention/access handling and a retrievable source trail for the quality-file context, with care for appropriate access to records.
DRAFTING STANDARD  A defensible narrative lets a reader retrieve each source, see the time-bound facts, recognize each inference and limitation, and understand exactly what the evidence does—and does not—establish.

criteria.description: 讲义定义或清楚地区分观察到的事实、推论、指控和未解决的差异。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找四个不同的概念，而不仅仅是同义词列表；每个都应该有一个可用的解释。

original.criterion: The handout defines or clearly distinguishes observed fact, inference, allegation, and unresolved discrepancy.
original.grader_hint: Look for four distinct concepts, not merely a list of synonyms; each should have a usable explanation.

criteria.description: 讲义始终将来源直接显示的内容与审阅者推断的内容分开，而不是将推论作为记录的事实呈现。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查示例是否分别标记或短语源观察和推论。

original.criterion: The handout consistently separates what a source directly shows from what the reviewer infers, rather than presenting an inference as a recorded fact.
original.grader_hint: Check whether the example labels or phrases the source observation and the inference separately.

criteria.description: 讲义指导审阅者确定叙述的时间窗口，并将陈述锚定在证据允许的日期或时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受对范围/日期界限和时间锚定的明确处理。

original.criterion: The handout instructs the reviewer to identify the narrative's time window and anchor statements to dates or times where the evidence permits.
original.grader_hint: Accept explicit treatment of scope/date bounds and time anchoring.

criteria.description: 该讲义需要可追溯的源跟踪来标识记录类型和足够的源详细信息，以便审阅者检索它。
criteria.grader_hint: 引用证据的通用指令是不够的，除非它解决了可检索性或来源识别问题。

original.criterion: The handout requires a traceable source trail that identifies the record type and enough source detail for a reviewer to retrieve it.
original.grader_hint: A generic instruction to cite evidence is insufficient unless it addresses retrievability or source identification.

criteria.description: 该讲义解释了如何描述缺失、不完整或冲突的记录，而不是默默地填补空白。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对缺席或冲突的明确承认以及对发明的完成的禁止。

original.criterion: The handout explains how to describe missing, incomplete, or conflicting records without silently filling the gap.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit acknowledgment of absence or conflict and a prohibition on invented completion.

criteria.description: 工作示例使用十一天晚上的打印输出集、报废批次标签和主管的2上午笔记本作为不同的证据来源。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有三种案件证据类型都必须出现，并且不得合并到一个不受支持的来源中。

original.criterion: The worked example uses the eleven-night andon-printout set, the scrapped-lot tag, and the supervisor's 2 a.m. notebook as distinct evidence sources.
original.grader_hint: All three case evidence types must appear and must not be merged into one unsupported source.

criteria.description: 工作示例将夹具停机时间视为对齐记录间隙的可能解释，同时明确地留下了未解决的解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当停机时间被视为相关性或可能的背景时才予以信用，而不是适当表现或不当行为的证据。

original.criterion: The worked example treats fixture downtime as a possible explanation for aligned record gaps while expressly leaving the explanation unresolved.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if downtime is framed as correlation or possible context, not proof of either proper performance or misconduct.

criteria.description: 该讲义指出，匿名举报是一项指控或线索，其本身并不表明身份、意图或伪造。
criteria.grader_hint: 该限制必须是明确的，并且必须至少涵盖举报的证据状态。

original.criterion: The handout states that the anonymous tip is an allegation or lead and does not itself establish identity, intent, or falsification.
original.grader_hint: The limitation must be explicit and must cover at least the evidentiary status of the tip.

criteria.description: 该讲义仅在有记录支持的范围内使用中性语言来命名一个人，并避免在没有证据的情况下归因动机。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估如果指定的员工或客户阅读这些措辞是否公平。

original.criterion: The handout gives neutral language for naming a person only to the extent supported by records and avoids attributing motive without evidence.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the wording would remain fair if read by the named employee or customer.

criteria.description: 该讲义解释了过渡期间纸质扭矩捕获到电子扭矩捕获转换的相关内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认记录在转换期间可能具有不同的来源或完整性，并且该期间必须受到限制。

original.criterion: The handout explains what should be said about the paper-to-electronic torque-capture transition during the interim period.
original.grader_hint: Look for acknowledgement that records may have different provenance or completeness during changeover and that the period must be bounded.

criteria.description: 该讲义根据记录的证据属性描述了完整的电子最终状态，例如事件时间、与相关工作或单位的链接以及可审核性，而无需规定软件点击。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文档应说明可用的最终状态记录所展示的内容，而不是特定的产品工作流程。

original.criterion: The handout describes the completed electronic end state in terms of the record's evidentiary attributes, such as event time, linkage to the relevant job or unit, and auditability, without prescribing software clicks.
original.grader_hint: The document should state what a usable end-state record demonstrates, not a particular product workflow.

criteria.description: 该讲义单独解决了一种罕见的情况，即未经检查的扭矩结果可能允许客户释放，并需要仔细区分曝光、证据和结论。
criteria.grader_hint: 例外情况必须明显与一般指导分开，并且不得简化为通用的升级语句。

original.criterion: The handout separately addresses the rare case in which an unchecked torque result may have permitted customer release and requires careful distinction between exposure, evidence, and conclusion.
original.grader_hint: The exception must be visibly separate from general guidance and must not be reduced to a generic escalation sentence.

criteria.description: 美国和加拿大安大略省被明确命名并在一般记录文档影响方面进行比较，包括中立性、可追溯性、保留或访问纪律以及客户质量背景，但没有断言具体的法律或法律结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要至少两个维度的真实比较；拒绝满足本项的合法引用或不受支持的认证声明。

original.criterion: The United States and Ontario, Canada are explicitly named and compared on general record-documentation implications, including neutrality, traceability, retention or access discipline, and customer-quality context, without asserting a specific law or legal result.
original.grader_hint: Require a genuine comparison with at least two dimensions; reject legal citations or unsupported certification claims as satisfying this item.

criteria.description: 该讲义为过时的叙述提供了一个实用的结构，涵盖范围、证据、时间顺序、局限性，以及对证据证实和未证实的内容的有限陈述。
criteria.grader_hint: 这些元素可以用标题、紧凑模板或散文来表达，但所有五个功能都必须存在。

original.criterion: The handout provides a practical structure for a dated narrative that covers scope, evidence, chronology, limitations, and a bounded statement of what the evidence does and does not establish.
original.grader_hint: The elements may be expressed as headings, a compact template, or prose, but all five functions must be present.

criteria.description: 讲义教导审阅者要保留迟到条目、丢失条目、检查失败和伪造条目之间的区别，除非记录能够明确区分。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找所有四种可能性或针对折叠它们的等效明确警告。

original.criterion: The handout teaches the reviewer to preserve the distinction between a late entry, a missing entry, a failed check, and a falsified entry unless the records establish the distinction.
original.grader_hint: Look for all four possibilities or an equivalent explicit warning against collapsing them.

criteria.description: 该文档不包含系统点击说明、访谈脚本、纪律建议或不受支持的操作程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否有违禁内容；这是一个积极的约束项目，而过度生产惩罚则单独解决无证据支持的案件索赔。

original.criterion: The document contains no system click-by-click instructions, interview script, disciplinary recommendation, or unsupported operational procedure.
original.grader_hint: Inspect for prohibited content; this is a positive constraint item, while the over-production penalty separately addresses unsupported case claims.

criteria.description: 新的质量或生产同行评审员可以使用讲义，而无需询问作者其标签的含义或如何应用其中立标准。
criteria.grader_hint: 一起判断清晰度、示例、定义和实际可用性；技术上正确但不透明的散文不应获得满分。

original.criterion: A new quality or production peer reviewer could use the handout without asking the author what its labels mean or how to apply its neutrality standard.
original.grader_hint: Judge clarity, examples, definitions, and practical usability together; technically correct but opaque prose should not receive full credit.

criteria.description: 该讲义是指导性的，而不是法律备忘录：它教导可重复的、有证据限制的写作习惯，同时保留陈述事实而不建议采取行动的权威限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找简洁的教学解释和示例，而不是命令式的过程或法律分析。

original.criterion: The handout is instructional rather than a legal memo: it teaches a repeatable evidence-bounded writing habit while preserving the authority limit of presenting facts without recommending action.
original.grader_hint: Look for concise teaching explanations and examples, not a command-heavy process or legal analysis.

criteria.description: 渲染后的 DOCX 不超过两页，并且在普通办公室查看或打印尺寸下仍然可读和可扫描。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算渲染的页面数；还要检查压缩是否导致讲义实际上无法使用。

original.criterion: The rendered DOCX is no more than two pages and remains readable and scannable at ordinary office viewing or printing size.
original.evidence: Rendered page count and visual inspection
original.grader_hint: Count rendered pages; also inspect whether compression makes the handout practically unusable.

criteria.description: 讲义以简明的起草标准或质量测试结束，而不是未来行动或后续步骤的列表。
criteria.grader_hint: 结局应该说明合理叙述的标准，而不应该成为行动计划。

original.criterion: The handout ends with a concise drafting standard or quality test, not a list of future actions or next steps.
original.grader_hint: The ending should state the standard for a defensible narrative and should not become an action plan.

criteria.description: 该文件对 Heronbank Systems 案例进行了连贯、公正的描述，适合包含在质量文件培训环境中。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估专业语气、内部一致性以及同行评审员是否可以安全地重复使用该材料。

original.criterion: The document presents a coherent, fair account of the Heronbank Systems case and is suitable for inclusion in a quality-file training context.
original.grader_hint: Assess professional tone, internal consistency, and whether a peer reviewer could safely reuse the material.

criteria.description: 该讲义声称，指定人员伪造、预先签名或故意绕过扭矩检查，或捏造超出所提供证据的案件事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果没有证据支持的罪责、意图、客户发布、日期、数量或其他虚构事实被陈述为已确定的而非假设的，则适用处罚。

original.criterion: The handout asserts as fact that a named person falsified, pre-signed, or intentionally bypassed a torque check, or invents case facts beyond the supplied evidence.
original.grader_hint: Apply the penalty if unsupported culpability, intent, customer release, dates, quantities, or other invented facts are stated as established rather than hypothetical.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

validation_record.label: 结构/材料验收记录
validation_record.detail: validated 属于结构、防泄漏、材料推进验收；没有内容正确率结论。

author_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: A domain-expert author drafts the document and an independent reviewer checks the rendered artifact against each rubric item, including usability and unsupported-claim penalty.
known_limitations: The jurisdiction comparison is intentionally general workplace-record and customer-quality guidance, not legal advice or a certification interpretation.
No supplied source records exist, so the handout must teach evidence-bounded practice rather than resolve the underlying hotline allegation.

not_claimed: 不是本轮agent独立内容复审通过
不是正式正确率或RewardKit验收
不是证明此批质量排名第一

gold_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: A domain-expert author drafts the document and an independent reviewer checks the rendered artifact against each rubric item, including usability and unsupported-claim penalty.
known_limitations: The jurisdiction comparison is intentionally general workplace-record and customer-quality guidance, not legal advice or a certification interpretation.
No supplied source records exist, so the handout must teach evidence-bounded practice rather than resolve the underlying hotline allegation.

spec.professional_context: This is a compact manufacturing-quality training handout for a peer reviewer preparing an evidence-bounded hotline investigation narrative during a record-system transition. It must be usable as a stand-alone reference while remaining neutral about individual culpability.
difficulty_sources: Separating evidence, inference, allegation, and unresolved discrepancy in a neutral manufacturing-quality narrative
Explaining the evidentiary implications of a paper-to-electronic record transition without writing system instructions
Handling a rare potential customer-release exposure without asserting an unsupported event
Comparing general documentation practice across the United States and Ontario, Canada
Fitting a genuinely usable instructional handout into two pages

authoring_plan.purpose: Create an instructional DOCX for a first-line manufacturing supervisor or quality peer reviewer learning to write a neutral, dated investigation narrative from incomplete records. The gold must be achievable from occupational knowledge alone and must not rely on hidden files.
case_constraints: Use Heronbank Systems as the manufacturing organisation and Ezra Kalinowski as quality manager; use the supplied case facts only: anonymous hotline allegation about B-shift torque-verification signatures, eleven nights of andon printouts with gaps, one scrapped-lot tag, the supervisor's 2 a.m. notebook, and apparent alignment of gaps with fixture downtime.
Keep the alleged person's identity, intent, whether a check occurred, and whether customer product was released unresolved unless explicitly supported by the case facts (they are not).

Include a separate rare-severe exception concerning possible customer release of product without a verified torque result, framing it as an exposure requiring careful factual treatment rather than as an established event.

Explain the paper sign-off to electronic torque-capture transition as an interim evidentiary complication and describe end-state records by qualities such as timestamp, unit/job linkage, operator attribution, and audit trail, without naming software steps.
instructional_specification: Define observed record, inference, allegation/lead, and unresolved discrepancy in plain language.
Teach bounded date scope, source retrievability, chronology, limitations, and a final statement limited to what the evidence establishes.
Explicitly warn that missing, late, failed, and falsified records are different propositions and cannot be collapsed.
Provide a compact clearly labeled worked example that uses all three evidence types and distinguishes known facts from illustrative wording.

Compare general documentation implications in the United States and Ontario, Canada: neutral wording, traceability, retention/access discipline, and customer-quality records. Avoid specific statutory or certification claims.
End with a concise drafting standard rather than future steps.
artifact_constraints: Exactly one top-level DOCX named factual_narrative_peer_briefing.docx.
Maximum two rendered pages, readable and scannable, with enough white space and hierarchy for a training handout.
No external references are needed; do not fabricate citations, regulations, dates, individuals, or operational findings.
Do not include click paths, interview questions, discipline recommendations, or a conclusion that anyone falsified records.
authoring_plan.gold_derivation: Have a domain-expert author draft the handout, then have an independent reviewer verify every rubric item against the rendered DOCX. The reference passes only if all credit predicates are present, the page constraint is met, and the unsupported-claim penalty is absent.

deliverables.description: A concise, practical training handout for a new quality or production peer reviewer on preparing a defensible factual investigation narrative from incomplete torque-verification records.
constraints: Write into the top-level starting working directory using exactly the specified filename.
Maximum two pages when rendered on ordinary office paper; use readable body text and clear navigation.
Use plain language and instructional examples, while distinguishing case facts, evidence, inference, allegation, and hypothetical illustration.
Address both the transition from paper sign-off to electronic torque capture and the completed electronic end state.
Include a separate treatment of the rare potential customer-release consequence.
